name: AnyLine line art
plain: AnyLine (TheMisto.ai): sharp line maps for line-conditioned ControlNets such as MistoLine, from the MTEED edge network blended with a line art of the image. MIT code; OpenRAIL++-M weights (commercial use with use restrictions).
summary: AnyLine preprocessor of MistoLine (TheMisto.ai; controlnet_aux `AnylineDetector`, ComfyUI-Anyline): the MTEED edge network (TEED architecture, weights by TheMisto.ai) blended with a Gaussian-difference line art whose small specks are removed; sharp line maps for line-conditioned ControlNets.

papers.title: Tiny and Efficient Model for The Edge Detection Generalization

licence_notes: The MTEED weights use the OpenRAIL++-M licence: commercial use is allowed but with use restrictions that must be passed on; the training data terms are not checked.
limitations: Layers are blended in float as TheMistoAI/ComfyUI-Anyline; controlnet_aux's `AnylineDetector` blends uint8 arrays, where `1 - (1 - top) * (1 - base)` wraps around, so its maps differ wherever line art is drawn.
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: a line / edge map `[H, W]` in [0, 1] at the input size (1 = line), the ControlNet preprocessors (line art, HED, PiDiNet, TEED / Anyline); M-LSD also returns straight line segments.

quality.title: BSDS500 test (200 images), boundary ODS / OIS / AP %
quality.protocol: All 200 BSDS500 test images. The benchmark uses the official boundary correspondence with a tolerance of 0.0075 of the image diagonal. ODS, OIS and AP use 99 thresholds on 8-bit predictions without thinning.

portable32.note: 1280-pixel detect short side. The portable resize uses the library's bicubic interpolation.

original32.note: Pinned controlnet_aux detector and Lanczos4 resize, with the authors' ComfyUI-Anyline float blend.

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.02 and p99 <= 0.25 (absolute error of the output `edges`).
